title: Applying the Law of Cosines to Oblique Triangles
originalTopic: Triangles and Geometry: Law of Cosines
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: In a triangle with side lengths a = 5 and b = 8, and included angle C = pi/3 (60 degrees), compute the exact length of the third side c.

steps.title: State the Law of Cosines
steps.explanation: Identify the formula relating three sides of an oblique triangle and one included angle.
steps.why: The Law of Cosines generalizes the Pythagorean theorem for non-right triangles.

steps.title: Substitute the Given Values
steps.explanation: Substitute a = 5, b = 8, and the exact special angle value cos(pi/3) = 1/2.
steps.why: Standard cosine evaluation at pi/3 rad (60 degrees).

steps.title: Solve for Side Length c
steps.explanation: Taking the positive square root gives the exact geometric side length c = 7.
steps.why: Geometric lengths must be strictly positive real quantities.
